patterns.note: Sections alternate between full-bleed dark backgrounds and lighter backgrounds, creating strong visual breaks and emphasizing content blocks.
Dramatic, oversized serif typography is used for primary headings, contrasting with clean, modern sans-serif for body text and UI elements.
A high-contrast monochrome palette of dark greys, black, and white is punctuated by a single vibrant pink accent color for interactive elements and highlights.
The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, while the hero background image exhibits a subtle parallax effect.
Client logos are presented in a horizontally scrollable strip, implying a larger collection and adding a dynamic element to the social proof section.

technique_notes: To rebuild the motion, implement a sticky header that remains fixed at the top of the viewport. For the hero, apply a subtle parallax effect to the background image, making it scroll at a slower rate than the foreground content. Utilize CSS keyframes to animate sections into view as they enter the viewport, such as a gentle fade-up or slide-in effect, to create a dynamic content reveal experience.

The visual design relies on full-bleed sections with alternating dark and light backgrounds to define content areas. Typography is used for dramatic effect, pairing a very large, elegant serif font for main statements with a clean, readable sans-serif for supporting text. A minimal color palette is used, with a single bright accent color strategically applied to draw attention to key interactive elements and brand highlights.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~4-5x body) with clean, readable sans-serif body text and small, uppercase sans-serif labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (minimal rounding on cards and buttons, mostly sharp edges).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a more balanced density within content blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its bold and dramatic use of typography, particularly the oversized, elegant serif headings that command attention. This is powerfully combined with a high-contrast, nearly monochrome palette and a single, vibrant accent color, creating a sophisticated and impactful brand presence that feels both modern and timeless.
